title: The Personality Trap: How LLMs Embed Bias When Generating Human-Like Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of the age attribute in synthetic personas generated from personality test scores to identify demographic skews toward younger individuals.

Examining the gender attribute distribution in LLM-generated personas based on personality profiles, including demographic shifts and non-binary representation when specific traits like Neuroticism or Psychoticism are maximized.
Evaluating the race attribute in synthetic populations generated from personality questionnaires to detect overrepresentation of White individuals.

Measuring the sexual orientation attribute in generated personas and assessing stereotype associations and potential pathologization (e.g., disproportionate LGBTQ+ representation) when the Psychoticism trait is maximized.
Analyzing the religious belief attribute in LLM-generated synthetic personas to identify overrepresentation of secular (agnostic/atheist) or Christian backgrounds.
Assessing the political orientation attribute in synthetic populations generated from baseline and manipulated personality traits to detect progressive or centrist skews.
Evaluating the occupation attribute in generated personas to identify biases toward highly educated, industrialized, and professional fields.
Examining the location attribute in LLM-generated synthetic populations to detect overrepresentation of Western, major metropolitan areas.
